scope: Access and discoverability diagnostics. The scorecard is not AE. No composite number or global ranking is produced. Unobserved engagement is missing, not zero.
disclosure: Designer-operated and self-reported. Wulf A. Kaal designed the AE proposal, appears in the 2024 Sisk-Leiter list, and is a colleague of its principal author. This exploratory project has a single operator and no independent co-maintainer yet.
limitations: The cohort comprises each school's ten most-cited faculty who resolved in OpenAlex. Field, career stage, language and publication-type effects are not adjusted. OpenAlex coverage of law is incomplete. Name matching errors exist.
classification_validation: No agent-traffic classifier is used in v0.1. Validation would require labeled samples, provider verification, false positive and false negative estimates, and an unknown category.
